crew.overview: Holly Golightly is an eccentric New York City playgirl determined to marry a Brazilian millionaire. But when young writer Paul Varjak moves into her apartment building, her past threatens to get in their way.
crew.title: Breakfast at Tiffany's

details.biography:
From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia.

Frank Inn was born as Elias Franklin Freeman , (May 8, 1916 - July 27, 2002) was an American animal trainer. He trained several animals for movies, but was most known for his work with the dogs in the Benji series.
